frozen_market.question: Will Zelenskyy and Putin not meet before 2027?
frozen_market.rule: Resolution by location of their next meeting through the cutoff; if none, “No meeting before 2027.” Meeting = any encounter in which both are present and interact in person. Remote calls/video conferences do not fit the stated definition. Ukrainian territory under de facto Russian control counts as Russia.
